essence: 深炭底、左侧大标题加半隐英文影字

recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): Sansheng deep-space dark cover: a deep charcoal canvas (#0E0E10), two zones: a calm text zone kept as dark negative space, and a hero zone with one clearly recognisable hero object plus two or three small evidence badges in a tidy collage (where each zone sits is given by the layout line); a restrained brand-green accent (#0E9F6E), low-contrast abstract lines; cinematic, calm and premium; no neon clutter, no glow spam, no gradient starfields.

role_styles.title: The headline is large, bold and white, and fills the text zone.
role_styles.ghost: The ghost line is a faint, low-contrast all-caps English line set directly behind the headline, clearly subordinate to it, made of exactly the characters given for it.

must_see: 深炭底、文字区留出大块安静的暗区
大标题加半隐英文影字
主体区一个认得出的主体物件加 2 到 3 个小徽章

changelog.note: 新增：封面调研后的封面类风格，准入待验证
加入叁笙自制的无人物风格参考板作为画风锚点（色板、材质、母题、构图），出图时自动当画风参考；不含人物与动物，避免内容串入。
文字与版式声明化：标题与影字改为 required_text_roles（清单缺角色编译即报错，有则进入逐字文字清单），版式用 layout 声明左文右图且在居中方形内分区；配方正文不再自带文字；无字档（音乐封面）的标题影字验收项只在有字时检查。
版式只由 recipe.layout 声明（正文与验收条目不再写死左右），清单可用 layout 字段覆盖文字区/主体区位置。
